resolved_intents.text: Prevent bypassing, materially degrading, or falsely treating as sufficient the required governed evaluation of a consequential decision in order to obtain advantage, reduce cost or effort, accelerate action, preserve resources, satisfy incentives, avoid scrutiny, or achieve another competing objective.

resolved_intents.name: Authorized Emergency Governance Does Not Constitute Bypass
